verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a way for users to define or schedule recurring scan jobs or workflows. The closest material is vendor claims of 'continuous' monitoring and tracking of key status, and those describe built-in behavior rather than user-configurable schedules. Pre-commit and pre-receive hooks are event-triggered, not scheduled, so they do not count toward a recurring-schedule capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
